summary: 3D ferry-captain game on a low-poly Bosphorus, built by Claude Fable 5.1 · Alçak poligon İstanbul Boğazı'nda 3D şehir hatları vapuru kaptanlığı, Claude Fable 5.1 yaptı
key_features: Six piers from Eminönü to Kanlıca with a timetable; late arrivals cost points and passengers
Docking guide for distance, speed and angle; dock slowly, parallel and close to throw the ropes
A current towards the Marmara and wind drift that grow over the campaign; tankers cannot stop quickly
Eight shifts (dusk, fog, night, strong current, storm, tanker convoy) and an endless mode
The ?auto captain finishes the campaign with 3 stars on every shift; 21-27 draw calls, 57 fps (vsync) on Intel UHD at 1280x720

social.headline: Captain an Istanbul ferry on the Bosphorus: keep the timetable and dock against the current · Boğaz'da vapur kaptanı ol: tarifeye uy, akıntıya karşı iskeleye yanaş
